name: Slice-Aware NTN
what_it_is: A Docker-based testbed that integrates Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) as slice-aware backhaul links in a 5G network, using free5GC as the core and UERANSIM as the RAN simulator, published at IEEE LCN 2021. The architecture is fully compliant with 3GPP Release 17 and supports both slice-aware and slice-unaware operating modes for comparative evaluation.
components: 3 UPFs (User Plane Functions, one per slice)
2 Slice Classifiers (RAN-NTN and NTN-CN interconnection points)
2 Trunks (GEO satellite link and LEO satellite link)
protocols: N2 / N3 / N4 interfaces (5G core reference points)
measurement: PCAP capture of all network traffic (~13 GB per iteration)
Probe files generated per iteration for post-hoc analysis
Matplotlib-based result visualization with LaTeX/TikZ export
Statistical validation via configurable iteration multiplicity
configuration: Global testbed settings via configuration.conf (image folders, service configs, output directories)
NTN link parameters: bandwidth, propagation delay, ACM (Adaptive Coding and Modulation) simulation
UE count and total scenario duration
Number of iterations for statistical repeatability
fault_injection: Try-retry policy: if any UE remains in IDLE state (failed PDU Session), the iteration is aborted and retried until all UEs reach CONNECTED state
modes: Slice-aware mode: routes traffic across GEO/LEO links according to per-slice QoS requirements
Slice-unaware mode: baseline routing without slice awareness, used as comparison baseline
constraints: Minimum 8 CPU cores, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB disk storage required to run the full scenario
Requires Linux kernel version compatible with free5GC (kernel-level GTP module)
Standard scenario spawns 64 containers and runs approximately 240 seconds
Each PCAP iteration produces approximately 13 GB of capture data, requiring substantial storage headroom
Docker and Docker Compose must be installed on the host
docker_services: UE-1 through UE-9 (UERANSIM user equipment instances)
Slice Classifier RAN-NTN (traffic classification at RAN-NTN boundary)
Slice Classifier NTN-CN (traffic classification at NTN-CN boundary)
notable_absences: No handover or mobility management across satellite links (UEs are stationary in the testbed)
No encryption or security plane testing; security mechanisms are not exercised
No real-world atmospheric or weather effects modeled beyond static propagation delay
No inter-slice interference mitigation mechanisms documented
Docker Compose file is not at the repository root (compose path non-standard; 64-service count from entry metadata)
No GUI or dashboard; all analysis requires post-processing of probe/PCAP files externally
